content.title: When Does Invincible Season 4 Episode 6 Drop on Prime Video?
content.text: Following a major character death, Invincible Season 4 is only heating up. Sam Connon breaks down everything you need to know before Episode 6 of the blockbuster animated show hits Prime Video. Invincible Season 4 is heading into the home stretch, with only three episodes left in the current arc. Amazon Prime Video’s violent animated superhero show is coming off a major development in Episode 5, but that doesn’t mean the story will be slowing down anytime soon. With one of the comic’s most iconic moments now in the rear-view mirror, here is everything you need to know before Season 4 Episode 6 comes out: New Character Breakdowns for Invincible Season 4 Dinosaurus Thragg When does Invincible Season 4 Episode 6 come out? Season 4 Episode 6 will premiere on Amazon Prime Video on Wednesday, April 8. The episode is titled YOU LOOK HORRIBLE and it is expected to have a runtime around 50 minutes. The fourth season will consist of eight episodes total. One episode will come out per week through the finale on April 22. (Warning: Spoilers for Invincible Season 4 Episode 5 ahead.) Who will show up this episode? The ensemble cast of Invincible is among the most expansive in all of television, so it’s hard to nail down exactly who will and won’t appear in any given episode. Still, here is a breakdown of who could pop up in Season 4 Episode 6: Steven Yeun as Mark Grayson a.k.a. Invincible J.K. Simmons as Nolan Grayson a.k.a. Omni-Man Sandra Oh as Debbie Grayson Christian Convery as Oliver Grayson a.k.a. Young Omni-Man Gillian Jacobs as Samantha Eve Wilkins a.k.a. Atom Eve Brandon Scott Jones as William Clockwell Walton Goggins as Cecil Stedman Chris Diamantopoulos as Donald Ferguson Seth Rogen as Allen the Alien Tatiana Maslany as Telia Peter Cullen as Thaedus Michael Dorn as Trokk a.k.a. Battle Beast Ben Schwartz as Shapesmith Khary Payton as Markus Grimshaw a.k.a. Black Samson Jay Pharoah as Zandale Randolph a.k.a. Bulletproof Ross Marquand as Rex Grey DeLisle as Monster Girl Chloe Bennet as Riley Clancy Brown as Damien Darkblood, Kregg and Ka-Hor Bruce Campbell as Satan Lee Pace as Thragg Matthew Rhys as Dinosaurus Danai Gurira as Universa Djimon Hounsou as Space Racer Zoey Deutch as Tech Jacket What to expect in Invincible Season 4 Episode 6 A Viltrumite warship ambushed Invincible, Omni-Man and the rest of the crew last episode, and chaos ensued. While Mark got beat to the brink, he managed to take Conquest off the board in the process. Still, the group that was meant to take down the remnants of the Viltrum Empire is scattered. Nolan and Oliver are tending to Mark, Allen the Alien and Tech Jacket are stowaways on the Viltrumite ship and Telia is heading back to Thaedus and the Coalition of Planets. Battle Beast and Space Racer are also out there, potentially ready to join the fight. Back on Earth, Eve is pregnant and only William knows. Damien Darkblood is back on the surface, the evil mummy Ka-Hor has finally escaped by possessing Riley and the Guardians of the Globe are reeling after Rex and Monster Girl got stranded in the Flaxan Dimension. Dinosaurus and Universa also haven’t gotten any screen time since their brief introductions in the season premiere. Invincible FAQs When does Invincible Season 4 Episode 6 come out? The fifth episode of Invincible Season 4 will premiere on Wednesday, April 8. Where can I watch Invincible? Season 4 Episode 6 will be available to stream on Amazon Prime Video. All previous episodes are also on Prime Video if you are looking to catch up. Will there be another season of Invincible? Amazon publicly renewed Invincible for a fifth season in July 2025. Going by the show’s recent schedule, Season 5 could air as soon as early 2027.
